name: secdeva/fieldTypes/layoutRow
description: Optional row in which the element is drawn in dataflow diagrams. Row 1 is the top row. Elements in the same row are drawn side by side in the order of the navigation tree. Elements inside a trust boundary inherit the row of the trust boundary. For OT systems, use one row per Purdue level, e.g. 1 = enterprise (L4–L5), 2 = DMZ (L3.5), 3 = operations (L3), 4 = control (L0–L2).
